caption: The drawing shows a formal garden plan viewed from above, contained within a square border with a light brown frame. Within the square, there are multiple rectangular and square plots of land outlined by green hedges or borders, and each section contains different arrangements of greenery, including rows of trees, flower beds, and grassy areas. The paths dividing the plots are colored in a light brown-beige hue. The garden features a circular flowerbed in one section, diagonal and vertical strips of flower beds with various colors such as pink, yellow, and white, and several areas densely filled with green, mimicking grass or low plants. Towards the upper part of the garden, there are two sections with scattered tree symbols. The top right section of the garden contains large rectangular areas shaded in tones of pale pink and green, indicating paved or tiled surfaces. Surrounding the square garden, at the top, is a horizontal strip containing pencil sketches and colored drawings. On the left is a pencil sketch of tall, blooming flowers. In the top center is a colored depiction of a garden niche with a statue surrounded by climbing greenery. On the right is a colored drawing of a multi-story building with a fence and additional vegetation. The entire composition is rendered in soft, muted tones of green, pink, beige, and brown, with distinct outlines separating each section.
title: Parmentier Grounds
